title: The Nixtlaverse: An Open-Source Ecosystem for Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2609.39741v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large forecasting applications often combine statistical, machine-learning, and neural models. These families solve the same problem but differ in fitted state, training procedures, and how they parallelize work. Forecasting software must therefore either hide these differences behind a single estimator interface, or keep the families in separate packages, forcing users to rewrite data preparation and evaluation for every package. We present the Nixtlaverse, an ecosystem of open-source Python libraries for time series forecasting, as a case study of a third design: all libraries share the same long-format panel data and keyed forecast outputs, while every model family keeps its own specialized implementation. We demonstrate this design through three use cases on the public M5 competition data. First, we evaluate statistical, machine-learning, and neural models, and an external engine from a separate ecosystem, in a single rolling-origin

translated_title: Nixtlaverse：一个用于时间序列预测的开源生态系统
translated_abstract: 大型预测应用通常需要结合统计模型、机器学习模型和神经网络模型。这些模型家族解决的是同一个问题，但在拟合状态、训练流程以及工作并行化方式上各不相同。因此，预测软件要么将这些差异隐藏在统一的估计器接口之后，要么将各模型家族分别放在独立的软件包中，迫使用户为每个软件包重复编写数据准备和评估代码。我们提出 Nixtlaverse——一个用于时间序列预测的开源 Python 库生态系统，作为第三种设计的案例研究：所有库共享相同的长格式面板数据和带键的预测输出，同时每个模型家族保留其各自专门化的实现。我们通过在公开的 M5 竞赛数据上的三个用例来展示这一设计。首先，我们在统一的滚动起源评估框架中评估统计、机器学习和神经网络模型，以及来自另一个生态系统的外部引擎
tldr: Nixtlaverse 是一个开源 Python 时间序列预测库生态系统，其核心创新在于所有库共享统一的长格式面板数据输入和带键预测输出，使统计、机器学习和神经网络等不同模型家族在保留各自专门实现的同时实现无缝组合与统一评估。
en_tdlr: The Nixtlaverse is an open-source Python ecosystem for time series forecasting whose key contribution is a unified design where all libraries share the same long-format panel data and keyed forecast outputs, enabling statistical, machine-learning, and neural model families to interoperate seamlessly while keeping their own specialized implementations.
